avoid.abilityText:
+1 Buy
The next time you shuffle this turn, pick up to 3 of those cards to put into your discard pile.

bury.abilityText:
+1 Buy
Put any card from your discard pile on the bottom of your deck.

deliver.abilityText:
+1 Buy
This turn, each time you gain a card, set it aside, and put it into your hand at end of turn.

foray.abilityText: Discard 3 cards, revealing them. If they have 3 different names, gain a Loot.

invasion.abilityText: You may play an Attack from your hand. Gain a Duchy. Gain an Action onto your deck. Gain a Loot; play it.

journey.abilityText: You don't discard cards from play in Clean-up this turn. Take an extra turn after this one (but not a 3rd turn in a row).

launch.abilityText: Once per turn: Return to your Action phase. +1 Card, +1 Action, and +1 Buy.

maelstrom.abilityText: Trash 3 cards from your hand. Each other player with 5 or more cards in hand trashes one of them.

mirror.abilityText:
+1 Buy
The next time you gain an Action card this turn, gain a copy of it.

peril.abilityText: You may trash an Action card from your hand to gain a Loot.

prepare.abilityText: Set aside your hand face up. At the start of your next turn, play those Actions and Treasures in any order, then discard the rest.

prosper.abilityText: Gain a Loot, plus any number of differently named Treasures.

rush.abilityText:
+1 Buy
The next time you gain an Action card this turn, play it.

scrounge.abilityText: Choose one: Trash a card from your hand; or gain an Estate from the trash, and if you did, gain a card costing up to $5.
